brief.t: START HERE: Call Aaron and Evelyn, with Sam looped in, to reconcile both Silk Factor lots and actual shipments before further fulfillment.

ACT NOW 1: Silk Factor disposition. November 13 discrepancy is 11 days old. Luke's client signature is verified, but microbial results, conflicting batch records/dates and lot-specific shipment traceability remain unresolved. Send internally: Aaron, Evelyn and Ron, reconcile both lots, shipments, microbial results and batch records against Luke's signed waiver with Sam today, then document authorized disposition before further fulfillment.

ACT NOW 2: Roon complaints and pre-run test window. New overnight: three refund reports in three weeks from recent fills, including one off smell on skin—not confirmed contamination. Josh requests R7 reconciliation and thicker-tube one-week dispensing checks before the requested December 1 run, seven days away. No revised formula or run date is approved by this email. Send internally: Ron, Aaron and Evelyn, review the three Roon complaints and affected lots against R7 with Sam today, then record the approved test plan and whether the one-week dispensing check can finish before any December 1 run commitment.

ACT NOW 3: Hunter audit today. Audit is today, November 24; hour and actual readiness remain unverified. First status was due November 20 at 4 PM, four calendar days ago. Planned installation November 23–25 is not commissioned machinery or validated cleaning. Send internally: Ron and Evelyn, confirm today's audit time and master-1138 gaps now; I'll provide my actual approved-document and resource status, with no backdating or claims of commissioning, training or cleaning verification that have not happened.
